correctness.rationale: The LCD-plane criterion is an exact two-by-two Gram determinant computation. The map \(T(z)=z+q(z)w\) converts the condition into a linear functional. Dimension bounds on the two preimages \(T^{-1}(C^\perp)\) and \(T^{-1}(D^\perp)\) leave a permissible vector for every \(n\ge4\), producing a path of length at most three. The explicit pair has no LCD common neighbor because every mixed two-plane has zero Gram determinant. The bundled exhaustive checker independently confirms the graphs for \(n=4,5,6\).

value.rationale: Diameter is a central global invariant of the newly studied LCD neighbor graph. The theorem resolves the first nontrivial binary dimension uniformly for all lengths, exposes a characteristic-two one-step defect relative to both the ambient Grassmann diameter and the stated odd-field formula, and supplies a structural obstruction plus constructive path proof rather than a routine enumeration.
